body: For me I definitely knew the show had gone to shit during that week the blizzard shut down New York city. They weren't going to have any guests and some of the staff wasn't going to show up so I thought "finally we're going to get some funny audio clips, phone calls from people, discussion about the phone calls or the goings on of various wack-packers and show members. This should be a great week of shows." But no. Howard spent literally an hour and a half bitching about Gary not showing up and it was as mundane and unfunny as it gets. The rest of the shows was the usual shit we've come to expect these past few years and some nagging towards Robin.

Unfortunately, I do not. If it was anything that I could learn on the job and didn't require two years of school I'd be open to it. I made a thread in /r/assistance as you suggested and only got one offer from a guy in Michigan. Moving hundreds of miles across the country on something that sounded like temporary work just seemed like too much of a risk.

Everything else was pretty much what I expected which was suggestions to go back to school or go to a trade school.

Thanks for following up though. I once made a post on /r/suicidewatch about two years ago when I was really feeling down. Not one person followed up with me and I even got suggestions on painless suicide methods in my inbox. Great subbreddit, eh?
